subject: Link's Tree House
text: The door in the northwest corner of Link's Tree House leads outside to Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Head out the door in the northwest corner.

subject: Saria
text: Saria approaches Link on his porch outside his tree house.

evidence.quote: On Link's porch, you will be approached by Saria, one of the game's more important sub characters.

subject: Mido
text: Mido blocks the archway leading to the Great Deku Tree and refuses to let Link pass until he finds both a sword and a shield.

evidence.quote: Jump across the small pool of water to the large arch that leads to the Great Deku Tree. Speak with Mido, the Kokiri who blocks your path. He'll refuse to let you pass until you find both a Sword and Shield (a task which he thinks is impossible, but we'll soon prove otherwise).

subject: Kokiri Sword
text: The Kokiri Sword is found inside a treasure chest on a tree trunk past the rolling boulder tunnel in the Kokiri Training Ground.

evidence.quote: Enter the small tunnel by standing in front of it and pressing A. Crawl to the tunnel's other side... Open the treasure chest sitting on the tree trunk to find the Kokiri Sword.

subject: Deku Shield
text: A shield must be bought from the shop for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote: Next item on your list is a Shield, which you'll have to buy from the shop for 40 rupees.

subject: Kokiri Training Ground
text: Navigating the alcoves along the boulder path yields two blue rupees and bushes that may drop rupees.

evidence.quote: Run left and into the small alcove. Take the blue rupee and slash the bush, and take the rupee that it may or may not drop... Run left around the corner, then another left. Take the blue rupee in the far alcove, then slash the bush which should (hopefully) yield another Rupee.

subject: Kokiri Training Ground
text: Targeting a rock outside the tunnel and performing repeated backflips awards a blue rupee and a green rupee.

evidence.quote: On the outside of the tunnel, Z-Target one of the rocks to the left. Begin performing backflips (hold back and press A) over and over until you reach the edge of the training ground. Run back towards the rock and repeat the backflips until you are awarded a blue rupee and a green rupee.

subject: Mido's House
text: The chests inside Mido's House contain 11 rupees and a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Open all of his chests for 11 rupees and a Recovery Heart.

subject: Mido's House
text: A blue rupee is located on the ledge behind Mido's House.

evidence.quote: Jump up to the ledge behind Mido's House, and look behind his house to find another Blue Rupee.

subject: Kokiri Forest Pond
text: Jumping across the platforms in the water awards a blue rupee upon reaching the opposite shore, and another blue rupee when repeated in the opposite direction.

evidence.quote: Run directly at these platforms, and run across them. Link will automatically jump from each one as you run along them. If you do it properly, after you have reached the opposite shore of the water you will receive a blue rupee. Repeat this in the opposite direction to receive another blue rupee.

subject: Kokiri Forest
text: The house in the southeast corner contains six rupees in pots, which respawn upon exiting and re-entering.

evidence.quote: The house in the southeast corner has the most rupees (six, look in the pots), and leaving then entering the house repeatedly will respawn the pots.

subject: Kokiri Shop
text: The Deku Shield can be purchased from the clerk at the Kokiri Shop.

evidence.quote: Purchase a Deku Shield from the clerk.

subject: Kokiri Forest
text: Climbing the vine-covered wall behind Mido's House and entering the large hollow log leads to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Head back to Mido's House in the northwest corner of the Kokiri Forest, then climb up on the ledge behind his house. Look for the wall covered in vines, then climb the vines to the top. Work your way around along the ledge and enter the large hollow log to enter the Lost Woods.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Business Scrub can be defeated by reflecting its Deku Nut back with the Deku Shield or by striking it with a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: To beat this Business Scrub and make him sell you his wares, either reflect his Deku Nut back into his face with the Deku Shield, or do a Jump Attack.

subject: Deku Stick Capacity Upgrade
text: The Business Scrub in the Lost Woods upgrades Link's Deku Stick carrying capacity to 20 for 40 rupees and fills his sticks.

evidence.quote: Speak with him, and he will upgrade the total amount of Deku Sticks you can carry to 20 for 40 rupees (and he'll maximize your Deku Sticks for free).

subject: Lost Woods
text: From the Business Scrub area, climbing the ladder and navigating through a series of hollow logs returns Link to Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Return to the opposite side of the valley and climb the ladder back to the top. Go through the hollowed log, then hang a right into another hollowed log. Go left or right (it doesn't matter which) through another hollowed log to return to the Kokiri Forest.

subject: Mido
text: Once Link has obtained both a sword and a shield, Mido permits him to pass through the passage toward the Great Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: Head to the east side of the area, back across the pond, and speak with Mido again. Now that you've lived up to his challenge to find a Sword and Shield, he'll let you pass.

subject: Deku Baba
text: Deku Babas in the passage die in one sword hit and leave behind Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: Halfway through it, you'll encounter a bunch of Deku Babas. These guys die in one hit from your sword, and leave behind Deku Sticks.

subject: Great Deku Tree
text: Entering the mouth of the Great Deku Tree begins the first dungeon.

evidence.quote: The Deku Tree will test Link and Navi, by having them enter his uh... mouth, and defeat the parasite that has been placed at his roots. Enter his mouth to begin the first dungeon.
